shortDescription: Equinor OSL:EQNR expects the European Union's gas storage to reach about 75% of its capacity by November, two of the firm's executives told Reuters on Wednesday.EU gas storage is 68.2% full, 16.2 percentage points below the five-year average, according to data from Gas Infrastructure Europe.
